news.title: GTHL: Congrats PeeWee A Flames!
news.description: The PeeWee A Flames won the MyHockey Fall Classic in Rochester NY over the Thanksgiving Weekend! Excellent effort by the entire team. Congrats!

news.title: Select: Minor Atom Red Take Gold at Vic Village
news.description: We are very proud of our Minor Atom Red team, who took home the gold at the Vic Village Tourney, this past weekend. Great start to the season!

news.title: GTHL: Bantam A Win Hillcrest Tournament
news.description: The Leaside Bantam A team won the Hillcrest Canadians Brian Steele Early Bird Tournament over the weekend. Congratulations Team! Go Flames! GO!!

news.title: 2019 Season Starting Soon!
news.description: Hockey Season is just around the corner, so please mark your calendars! The season will start the weekend of September 21/22 and will run through March 28/29. We look forward to seeing you at the arena soon!
